findings.fixture: netcdf_probe.py generates xarray/netCDF4 2x2 matrix with missing_cell.nc and only three cells
findings.oracle: Independent xarray fixture and source-cell manifest
findings.expected: Reject incomplete topology before returning a complete-looking 2x2 matrix.
findings.actual: Returns shape (2,2,3); cell r1,c1 has no source assignment. Classification is based on accepted incomplete topology, not the incidental bytes in np.empty.

findings.fixture: duplicate_cell.nc contains a second variable at (r0,c0) with value 99 while original c00 has 11
findings.oracle: Independent xarray source-cell inventory
findings.expected: Reject two source variables assigned to one matrix cell.
findings.actual: Returns the last value 99 at r0,c0, dropping the original value 11.

findings.fixture: same_key_different_index.nc and same_col_key_different_index.nc
findings.oracle: Independent xarray cell key/index attributes
findings.expected: Reject one row or column key mapped to conflicting indices.
findings.actual: Returns a dense matrix and normalizes the conflicting axis labels, discarding source index meaning.

findings.fixture: different_key_same_index.nc and different_col_key_same_index.nc
findings.oracle: Independent xarray cell key/index attributes
findings.expected: Reject distinct row or column keys assigned the same index.
findings.actual: Returns both keys in a dense output axis without preserving the contradictory source index mapping.

findings.fixture: negative_index.nc and negative_col_index.nc
findings.oracle: Independent xarray cell index attributes
findings.expected: Reject a negative row or column index.
findings.actual: Returns a matrix with the affected axis reordered to include the negative-index key.

findings.fixture: sparse_index.nc, sparse_col_index.nc, out_of_range_index.nc, out_of_range_col_index.nc
findings.oracle: Independent xarray cell index attributes
findings.expected: Reject sparse, nonzero-based, or out-of-range row/column indices.
findings.actual: Returns a dense matrix with the source index meaning dropped; all variants returned shape (2,2,3).

findings.fixture: unit_mismatch.nc uses V for three cells and m for c11
findings.oracle: Independent xarray variable unit attributes
findings.expected: Reject incompatible units or retain per-cell distinctions.
findings.actual: Returns all four cells labeled V; c11 value 22 is mislabeled as volts.

findings.fixture: Attempted per-cell sample-length mismatch on a shared sample dimension.
findings.oracle: NetCDF shared dimension semantics
findings.expected: A valid fixture must reach the public reader with genuinely different cell lengths.
findings.actual: The shared sample dimension fixes one length; no valid independent fixture was found.

findings.fixture: Attempted distinct per-cell t0/dt attributes in the v2 matrix schema.
findings.oracle: NetCDF v2 schema timing is file-global
findings.expected: A valid fixture must establish an authoritative separate cell axis.
findings.actual: Extra per-cell t0/dt attrs are ignored and do not establish distinct source axes.
